---
title: "Page-section Example"
filters:
  - page-section
---

This filter creates a HTML markup for a page section.
\
\
This code

```md
::: {.page-section section_name='intro'}
The content.
:::
```

produces:

```html
<div class="page-section page-section-intro">
  <div class="page-section-content container page-section-intro__content">
    The content
  </div>
</div>
```

## Options

- `content_class` (string): adds one or more classes to the `page-section-content` div.
- `has_bg_color` (string): adds a background color. The following is supported:
  - `has_bg_color='primary'` for a red background color. In case of a primary background color, a `text-white` class is automatically added to the `page-section-content` div.
  - `has_bg_color='secondary'` for a gray background color
- `section_name` (string): adds a CSS class to the `page-section` and `page-section-content` div.
